title: C rpl: DAO TX state machine (reserve_next/finalize_signed) over the two-slot primitive
description: Child of b7z9.11, lands after the C two-slot primitive. Port rust/lichen-rpl/src/persistence.rs DaoTxState (lines 252-329) to C: provision (pubkey+local_origin+instance+dodagid payload, generation 1), reserve_next (generation+1 persisted BEFORE TX with the tx-state payload), finalize_signed (persist exact signed bytes for the reserved sequence; reject sequence mismatch, oversized, already-finalized), open/load on boot (missing/corrupt -> stop origination per R-09-014/016), no equal-sequence rebuild, terminal at u64 max (no wrap). Payload layout must be documented and cross-checked against the Rust encode_tx_state (pubkey 32 + origin 16 + instance + dodagid 16 + sequence u64 + signed-dao bytes/bounds). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.11.
